annotation.title_clean: Report on the stakeholder consultation and engagement activities (Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Communication Establishing a European Declaration on Digital rights and principles for the Digital Decade)
annotation.title_en: Report on the stakeholder consultation and engagement activities (Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Communication Establishing a European Declaration on Digital rights and principles for the Digital Decade)
annotation.summary_en: Commission staff working document reporting the consultation activities behind the European Declaration on Digital Rights and Principles: roadmap feedback, public consultation (609 replies), Eurobarometer survey, workshops, targeted consultations and a desk analysis of 30 initiatives. Respondents broadly support the principles; AI appears only as the 'human-centric algorithms' area.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public consultation drew 609 replies; respondents broadly supported a digital rights and principles declaration.
Eurobarometer (26,530 respondents): 82% want a common European vision on digital rights.
Respondents asked that principles complement rather than replace legal obligations and avoid duplicating the AI Act.
Human-centric algorithms principle on well-being received less support and was seen as ambiguous.
Desk analysis found AI covered in 13 of 30 initiatives, mainly transparency, accountability and non-discrimination.
